chapters.reason: Paper focuses on Transformer-to-SSM conversion via distillation (Training-induced Hidden-State Conversion), i.e., converting fixed-architecture Transformers to hidden-state RNN/SSM models.
Discusses linear-state recurrence and state-space updates, which aligns with subquadratic, matrix-valued hidden-state dynamics used by SSMs.
Touches on architectural recurrence concepts and recurrent computation, relevant to the idea of using recurrent/SSM structures as successors to Transformers.
